ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Dominantly low-intensity (black) distribution; high-intensity (white) pixels comprise less than 5% of the visible fluke surface, primarily localized to surface anomalies and marginal encrustations.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Surface is characterized by a uniform low-intensity field; distinct high-contrast pixel clusters are mapped to the distal tips of both lobes and discrete linear coordinates in the medial-right and proximal-central regions.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Narrow V-shaped depression with a calculated internal pixel angle of approximately 18 degrees and deep vertical penetration relative to the trailing edge baseline.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: Right lobe trailing edge displays high-frequency, rhythmic serrations with pixel amplitudes of 5-15 units; left lobe displays irregular, lower-frequency topography with a heavily fragmented and ragged distal termination.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Symmetric convex sweep from the peduncle attachment to the distal tips, with the right lobe trajectory exhibiting high-frequency modulation due to edge serrations.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: High-contrast, roughly circular pixel clusters detected at the distal margins of both lobes, suggesting dense colonization at the extreme coordinates of the fluke structure.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Distinct, unaligned white linear pixel disruptions visible on the medial right lobe (horizontal orientation) and near the median notch (vertical orientation).

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Significant physical fragmentation of the left lobe distal tip; extensive high-contrast irregular accumulation of material/organisms on the terminal edges of both lobes.
other_distinctive_markers: Pronounced asymmetry in trailing edge topography between the right lobe (rhythmic serration) and left lobe (irregular/fragmented wear).
